verdict.rationale: Sentry's Seer is a first-party, in-product AI layer. It automatically scans incoming issues to find root causes and automate triage, and Autofix generates code fixes. Seer Agent answers natural-language questions by finding the relevant telemetry, which delivers AI insights and suggestions drawn from the user's own data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and in-depth documentation of how insights appear across dashboards, traces and other in-product surfaces beyond short feature summaries.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ask any question about your application and Seer Agent finds the right telemetry to answer it.
Autofix: Automatically scan issues as they come into Sentry, finding root causes, and automating triage.
PR Creation: Use Autofix to generate a code fix and create a PR.
